description:
Adds a Transit Overlay button to the top-left of the screen, next to the Layers button. Click it and your network is sent to the Transit Overlay desktop app, a planning companion that runs next to the game.

The app draws your lines on the roads and tracks they use, shows which homes, jobs, industries and businesses your stops reach, and lets you plan new lines and stops before you build them. A heatmap shows where people no stop reaches live, with suggested spots for new stops, and you can export your network as a metro-style schematic map. It also shows cargo supply per good, town demand, and the map's terrain with water and hills.

Languages: English and German. The app starts in German when Windows is set to German, or switch in Settings → Map display → Language.

How it works
- The button reads your save (lines, stops, catchment, buildings, cargo, roads, vehicle routes and terrain) and writes it to the game log.
- The desktop app watches the game log and updates within a couple of seconds.
- Nothing in your save is changed. The mod only reads data and adds one button, so it can be added to and removed from a save at any time.

The desktop app (Windows and Linux) and its source: https://github.com/axelferb/Transport-Fever-3---Transit-Overlay

Reporting a problem: include the lines starting with [transit_overlay] or TFO|ERR from stdout.txt in Steam\userdata\<your Steam id>\3493540\local\crash_dump.

Auf Deutsch
Die Mod fügt oben links einen Transit-Overlay-Button hinzu. Ein Klick schickt dein Netz an die Desktop-App Transit Overlay: Linien auf den echten Straßen und Gleisen, Abdeckung deiner Haltestellen mit Heatmap und Vorschlägen für neue Haltestellen, Fracht und Netzplan-Export. Die App ist komplett auf Deutsch verfügbar (⚙ Einstellungen → Kartenanzeige → Sprache) und startet automatisch auf Deutsch, wenn Windows auf Deutsch eingestellt ist. Der Spielstand wird nicht verändert.
name: Transit Overlay
summary: One button that sends your lines, coverage, cargo and terrain to the Transit Overlay planning app. In English and German.
